page.title: Juicebox
page.subtitle: Squeezed with love. Not from Concentrate.
page.heroDescription: Featuring fully UV-printed artwork illustrated in-house and a glass front panel with subtle depth, and its signature magnetic straw, Juicebox remains one of our most iconic designs. A timeless, adorable fan-favorite that brightens any setup.

content.title: Gaming Needs More Purple!
content.description: It’s a comment we kept seeing across the internet, and we completely agree. One of our favorite things to do is create designs people truly love, even if it’s not something you normally see in the gaming space. So we made Grape Juicebox.

content.title: Limited Drop: Peaches & Cream
content.description:
Blending warm peach tones with creamy pink highlights, Peaches & Cream is the sweetest ever addition to the Ironside Juicebox shelf. Getting the dreamy colors exactly right took a lot of time, but was totally worth it. You’ll understand when it arrives - it’s hard to take your eyes off of these delightful pastels. 

Peaches & Cream is a limited drop — once it’s gone, it’s gone.

content.title: Juiced Up
content.description: Now built on a full ATX chassis, Juicebox gives you more room to play. Whether you’re running high-end GPUs, custom cooling, or future-proofing your build, the expanded layout offers the flexibility and airflow to support it all without losing the compact charm that made Juicebox a favorite.

content.title: Freshly Squeezed
content.description: Each Juicebox variant has been illustrated in-house in irresistible flavors like honeydew melon and peach, and we obsessed – hard – over making the colors of each design utterly delightful. The chassis features a mix of glass and metal panels, all UV-printed for vibrant, durable, and highly detailed designs.

content.title: The Juicy Bits
content.description: From the all new magnetic straw that snaps satisfyingly into place to the playful nutrition label printed on the back, Juicebox is filled with thoughtful details that bring the design to life.

content.title: Depth in Every Drop ✦₊⁺⟡
content.description: A new glass front panel brings added depth to the design. Subtle shadows shift beneath the surface as the light changes, which highlights the chassis’ build materials in a unique, elevated way.

content.quote: “In recent years, it feels like the playful spirit of all things ‘kawaii’ has spread like wildfire, and it brings us so much joy to bring some of that energy into something as traditionally serious as a gaming computer. Each of our Juiceboxes has been illustrated in house in delightful variations such as honeydew melon green and peach pink. The Juicebox line is undeniably unique and has brought many gleeful smiles to our team. I have no doubt that they will continue to delight their owners for years to come.”

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
